# Exporter Lead Generator - AI B2B Buyer Discovery

> Natural-language search over verified exporter and buyer data, turning a plain question into a qualified list.

Author: Muhammad Tanveer (Full-Stack AI Automation Engineer)
Contact: mtanveertahir66@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-tanveer-advenno/
Repository: https://github.com/haddindeve/exporter-lead-generator-ai
Source availability: implementation held in a private repository; access on request.

## Summary
Exporters looking for buyers work through directories and trade listings by hand. Finding companies that match a specific product, market and size means many searches and a lot of manual filtering, repeated for every new market.

A natural-language query layer over collected and verified company data. The operator describes the buyer they want in plain language; the system translates that into structured filters, runs it against the dataset, and returns a qualified list with the contact detail needed to act on it.

## Stack
Language: Python, Query: LLM-driven natural-language interpretation, Data: Verified company and contact dataset, Testing: Automated test suite

## Capabilities
- Plain-language buyer search
- Verified contact data
- Profile-based qualification
- Exportable qualified lists
- Repeatable market research runs

## Outcomes
- Directory research reduced to a single described query
- Repeatable per-market runs instead of one-off manual searches

## FAQ
Q: What does natural-language search mean here?
A: You describe the buyer you want in a sentence; the system converts that into structured filters and runs it against the dataset.

Q: Where does the data come from?
A: Collected company records passed through a verification step before they reach the result set.

Q: Who is it for?
A: Exporters and trade businesses that need buyer discovery in specific markets.

Q: Is the implementation public?
A: No - private repository, access on request.
